name: Malik Johnson
title: Open Gate Hour
summary:
Malik Johnson is gate-square host who gives newcomers the mic before the rumor does. The life that shows in public is anchored at Arrival square radio tent. Malik’s microphone still works, and the square wants a voice that can explain the gate. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Charismatic, fair, and quick to hand someone else the mic. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the place looks stable because they hide the repair and the person in front of them now resembles that old mistake. If that truth surfaces at Arrival square radio tent, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
